commit.author: Timo Sulg <timgluz@gmail.com>

lines.content: 3. Wait for upstream Astro/TS tooling to add TS7 support before finishing the migration — indefinite timeline, blocks progress for no clear win given `.astro` files are a small fraction of the codebase.

Current default (pending user input): **option 1** — proceeding without `astro check` in scripts/CI, `tsc --noEmit` stays as the type-safety gate. `package.json` scripts (Phase 9/10) will use `"build": "tsc --noEmit && astro build && node scripts/copy-wasm.mjs"` (no `astro check` step) unless the user picks a different option.
- Verified: `npx vitest run` (208 tests), `npx tsc --noEmit` (clean), and `npm run build:check` (existing Vite site, unaffected) all still pass after these changes.

- **`astro check`/TypeScript 7 blocker — RESOLVED.** User approved downgrading TypeScript project-wide (option 2 from the three listed above). Downgraded `typescript` `7.0.2` → `6.0.3` (exact pin, latest stable 6.x) and reinstalled `@astrojs/check@^0.9.9` (clean install this time, no `--legacy-peer-deps` needed — peer range `^5.0.0 || ^6.0.0` now satisfied). `astro check` runs successfully: 0 errors, 0 warnings, 1 pre-existing hint (`CSSProperties` deprecation in `src/explainers/fourier.tsx`, unrelated to this migration, not fixed). Re-verified `tsc --noEmit`, `npx vitest run` (208 tests), and `npm run build:check` all still pass under TS 6.0.3. `package.json` scripts not yet updated to include an `astro check` step — still deferred to Phase 9/10 alongside the `vite.config.ts` deletion/script cutover, per the Phase 1 deviation noted above.
- Next: Phase 2 (content collections) — `src/content/config.ts`, frontmatter codemod across the 18 `docs/algorithms/*.md` files (including `stochastic-hill.md`), one placeholder blog post.

- **`astro check` cannot run against TypeScript 7** (see Phase 1 log above) — not blocking overall migration progress, but the user should confirm the default of "skip `astro check`, rely on `tsc --noEmit`" is acceptable, or pick an alternative, before Phase 9/10 finalizes CI scripts.

commit.message:
Resolve astro-check/TS7 blocker: downgrade to TypeScript 6.0.3

User approved project-wide TS downgrade. astro check now runs clean
(0 errors). Full verification (tsc, vitest, existing vite build) still
green.

Implements [[tasks/teeline-web-astro7-migration]]
